texts.facts: The complainant has filed the present contempt petition alleging willful disobedience of the order dated 05. 06. 2024 passed by the Division Bench of this Court in W.P.No.23526/2023 (S- KSAT).
texts.arguments: It is contended on behalf of the accused that in compliance of the said order, the representation of the complainant has been considered and an endorsement has been made. 2. The learned counsel for the complainant submits that the order dated 05.06.2024 has been partly complied with. Although the representation has been considered, the salary has not been released. He submits that notwithstanding the rejection of the representation, to be appointed to the post of a Food Safety Officer, the complainant would be entitled to the salary for the said post in view of the order dated 05.06.2024. NC: 2025:KHC:37472-DB HC-KAR 3. It is contested by the learned counsel for the accused that there are no unequivocal directions for release of the salary. On the contrary, the order uses the words 'consequently payable'. The applicant's such salary is attached to the post of the Food Safety Officer.
texts.petitioner_arguments: It is contended on behalf of the accused that in compliance of the said order, the representation of the complainant has been considered and an endorsement has been made. 2. The learned counsel for the complainant submits that the order dated 05.06.2024 has been partly complied with. Although the representation has been considered, the salary has not been released. He submits that notwithstanding the rejection of the representation, to be appointed to the post of a Food Safety Officer, the complainant would be entitled to the salary for the said post in view of the order dated 05.06.2024. NC: 2025:KHC:37472-DB HC-KAR 3. It is contested by the learned counsel for the accused that there are no unequivocal directions for release of the salary. On the contrary, the order uses the words 'consequently payable'. The applicant's such salary is attached to the post of the Food Safety Officer.
